changes_made.explanation: Simplified guideline to core procedural descriptions. Removed sub-criteria that were components of the main criteria (fluency, coherence, context-relevance are aspects of appropriateness; diverse information is part of informativeness).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on dialogue generation with concept planning and non-autoregressive generation. The metadata extraction was generally accurate. Main changes involved normalization of metric names and streamlining of human evaluation criteria. The paper uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, distinctness) and human evaluations (pairwise comparisons) but does not use LLMs as judges.
